name: additional node auth scope requirement
description: Links an additional required scope to an auth-scope link

properties.name: scope link id
properties.description: ID of the auth-scope link that requires the additional scope

properties.name: scope id
properties.description: ID of the additional authorization scope required by the node.

name: api
description: Represents a documented API

properties.name: name
properties.description: (Human readable) name of this API

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this api was added to the database

name: api node
description: Represents an individual API node implementation

properties.name: group id
properties.description: ID of the node group this node belongs to

properties.name: name
properties.description: Human-readable name of this node

properties.name: name no spaces
properties.description: A lowercase version of the node name, with no whitespace included. Used for indexing & search.

properties.name: relative path
properties.description:
Path of this node, relative to the parent node (if defined) or the API root (if no parent is defined). 
May contain path parameters.

properties.name: parent id
properties.description:
ID of the node that appears directly above/before this node on the path. 
None if no parent node appears between this node and the API root.

properties.name: description
properties.description: A description of this API node.

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this api node was added to the database

properties.name: deprecated after
properties.description: Time when this api node became deprecated. None while this api node is still valid.

name: api node group
description: Defines a group of API nodes

properties.name: api id
properties.description: ID of the API this node group belongs to

properties.name: name
properties.description: (Human readable) name of this node group

properties.name: description
properties.description: Description of this group's function or theme

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this api node group was added to the database

properties.name: deprecated after
properties.description: Time when this api node group became deprecated. None while this api node group is still valid.

name: api node method implementation
description: Describes how a specific HTTP method is implemented in an API node.

properties.name: node id
properties.description: ID of the API node that contains this implementation.

properties.name: method
properties.description: The implemented method.

properties.name: description
properties.description: A description of this implementation.

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this api node method implementation was added to the database

properties.name: deprecated after
properties.description: Time when this api node method implementation became deprecated. None while this api node method implementation is still valid.

properties.name: requires request body
properties.description: Whether a request body is required for this implementation.

name: api node method implementation model schema link
description: Links a model schema to to an API node's method implementation.

properties.name: implementation id
properties.description: ID of the method implementation that uses the linked schema.

properties.name: model type id
properties.description: ID of the schema that defines the type of model accepted by the linked implementation.

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this api node method implementation model schema link was added to the database

properties.name: deprecated after
properties.description: Time when this api node method implementation model schema link became deprecated. None while this api node method implementation model schema link is still valid.

name: node auth link
description: Common trait for links between API nodes and possible authorization requirements

properties.name: node id
properties.description: ID of the node that accepts the linked authorization method.

properties.name: auth id
properties.description: ID of the authorization element accepted by the linked node.

properties.name: method
properties.description:
The HTTP method that the linked authorization method is used for. 
None if the authorization method is used as a default for all methods (where not overridden).

properties.name: description
properties.description: A description concerning this authorization method's function in the linked node.

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this node auth link was added to the database

properties.name: deprecated after
properties.description: Time when this node auth link became deprecated. None while this node auth link is still valid.

name: node auth scope link
description:
Describes an authorization scope required by an API node. 
If multiple scopes are linked, they typically represent alternative auth scopes, usually for different purposes.

properties.name: node id
properties.description: ID of the node that accepts the linked authorization method.

properties.name: scope id
properties.description: ID of the authorization scope required by the linked node.

properties.name: method
properties.description:
The HTTP method that the linked authorization method is used for. 
None if the authorization method is used as a default for all methods (where not overridden).

properties.name: description
properties.description: A description concerning this authorization method's function in the linked node.

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this node auth link was added to the database

properties.name: deprecated after
properties.description: Time when this node auth link became deprecated. None while this node auth link is still valid.

name: node auth type link
description: Describes an authorization type accepted by an API node.

properties.name: node id
properties.description: ID of the node that accepts the linked authorization method.

properties.name: auth type id
properties.description: ID of the authorization type accepted by the linked node.

properties.name: method
properties.description:
The HTTP method that the linked authorization method is used for. 
None if the authorization method is used as a default for all methods (where not overridden).

properties.name: description
properties.description: A description concerning this authorization method's function in the linked node.

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this node auth link was added to the database

properties.name: deprecated after
properties.description: Time when this node auth link became deprecated. None while this node auth link is still valid.

name: path parameters schema link
description: Applies a specific schema to the path parameters received by an API node.

properties.name: node id
properties.description: ID of the API node that accepts these parameters.

properties.name: model type id
properties.description: ID of the model type that describes the received path parameters.

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this path parameters schema link was added to the database

properties.name: deprecated after
properties.description: Time when this path parameters schema link became deprecated. None while this path parameters schema link is still valid.

name: possible response status
description: Defines a possible response status for an API node method call.

properties.name: implementation id
properties.description: ID of the implementation that may return this response status.

properties.name: status code
properties.description: HTTP status code that may be returned by the API node method call.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Description of what this status signifies.

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this possible response status was added to the database

properties.name: deprecated after
properties.description: Time when this possible response status became deprecated. None while this possible response status is still valid.

properties.name: has body
properties.description: Whether a response body is returned with this status. Uncertain if not specified in the documentation.

name: query parameters schema link
description: Applies a specific schema to the query parameters accepted by an API node.

properties.name: implementation id
properties.description: ID of the method implementation that uses the linked schema.

properties.name: model type id
properties.description: ID of the schema that defines the type of model accepted by the linked implementation.

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this api node method implementation model schema link was added to the database

properties.name: deprecated after
properties.description: Time when this api node method implementation model schema link became deprecated. None while this api node method implementation model schema link is still valid.

name: request body schema
description:
Applies a specific schema to the request body accepted by an API node. 
Multiple alternative schemas may be defined separately.

properties.name: implementation id
properties.description: ID of the method implementation that uses the linked schema.

properties.name: model type id
properties.description: ID of the schema that defines the type of model accepted by the linked implementation.

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this api node method implementation model schema link was added to the database

properties.name: deprecated after
properties.description: Time when this api node method implementation model schema link became deprecated. None while this api node method implementation model schema link is still valid.

properties.name: custom content type
properties.description: Non-standard content type expected from the request body, if applicable.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Description of the expected request body.

properties.name: is array
properties.description: Whether a JSON array is expected.

name: response content type
description: Defines how an API node's response body is formed.

properties.name: status id
properties.description: ID of the status this type of response body is returned with.

properties.name: content type
properties.description: If this body is non-empty, specifies the type of content it contains.

properties.name: model type id
properties.description: If this body contains a JSON object or objects, contains the ID of the model schema that describes the applicable object structure.

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this response content type was added to the database

properties.name: deprecated after
properties.description: Time when this response content type became deprecated. None while this response content type is still valid.

properties.name: is array
properties.description: Whether this response body contains an array of values. False if no more than one value may be returned.

properties.name: is empty
properties.description: Whether this response body is empty / no response body is returned.

name: auth token type
description: Represents some (custom) token type used by the documented API.

properties.name: api id
properties.description: ID of the API where this token type is used.

properties.name: name
properties.description: (Human-readable) name of this token type

properties.name: name no spaces
properties.description: A lowercase copy of this token's name with all whitespaces removed. Used for indexing and search.

properties.name: use type
properties.description: Determines how this token is applied.

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this auth token type was added to the database

properties.name: deprecated after
properties.description: Time when this auth token type became deprecated. None while this auth token type is still valid.

name: scope
description: Represents an authorization scope in the documented API.

properties.name: api id
properties.description: ID of the API where this scope is used.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Name / identifier of this scope.

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this scope was added to the database

properties.name: deprecated after
properties.description: Time when this scope became deprecated. None while this scope is still valid.

name: alternative property type
description: Defines an alternative supported data type for a property.

properties.name: prop id
properties.description: ID of the property that has this alternative type

properties.name: alt type
properties.description: Alternative data type supported by the linked property

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this alternative property type was added to the database

properties.name: deprecated after
properties.description: Time when this alternative property type became deprecated. None while this alternative property type is still valid.

name: model schema
description: Defines properties in an input or output model / JSON object.

properties.name: api id
properties.description: ID of the API this model type belongs to.

properties.name: name
properties.description:
Name of this model type (/class). Empty if unnamed. 
Named model types are often referenced from multiple sources, while unnamed types are typically single-use.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Description of this model type's role / function.

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this model schema was added to the database

properties.name: deprecated after
properties.description: Time when this model schema became deprecated. None while this model schema is still valid.

name: possible property value
description: Defines a possible value for an enum property

properties.name: prop id
properties.description: ID of the property that this value may be assigned to

properties.name: value
properties.description: The value the linked property may have

properties.name: description
properties.description: Description of this value's role / function

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this possible property value was added to the database

properties.name: deprecated after
properties.description: Time when this possible property value became deprecated. None while this possible property value is still valid.

name: property schema
description: Defines an individual property in a model schema.

properties.name: model type id
properties.description: ID of the model type that this property belongs to.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Name of this property, as it should appear in the input or output model / JSON object.

properties.name: data type
properties.description: This property's expected value type.

properties.name: content type id
properties.description:
If this property contains a model/object, this is the ID of the contained model's type. 
None if this property uses some other data type.

properties.name: description
properties.description: A description of this property's role/function.

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this property schema was added to the database

properties.name: deprecated after
properties.description: Time when this property schema became deprecated. None while this property schema is still valid.

properties.name: is array
properties.description: Whether this property is an array of values. False if this property contains a single value.

properties.name: is optional
properties.description: Whether this property may be omitted from the input and/or output.
